summary: A fun entertainment app for gaming, watching movies, and listening to music. Features a wallpaper collection that users can browse and select as backgrounds.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Light gray diagonal plaid pattern with black lace trim along the bottom edge, clean and delicate textile aesthetic (white-plaid-lace.dim_1280x720.jpg)
- High-contrast black background with large off-white Stussy graffiti-style logo text on the left and a close-up of bared teeth on the right, grungy streetwear aesthetic (dark-stussy-grunge.dim_1280x720.jpg)

Add 'White Plaid Lace' and 'Dark Stussy Grunge' as selectable thumbnail options in the PersonalizationPanel component alongside the existing wallpaper thumbnails, maintaining the existing 4-column grid layout.

Add 'White Plaid Lace' and 'Dark Stussy Grunge' as selectable options in the Personalization page (frontend/src/pages/Personalization.tsx), displaying their thumbnails in the existing grid alongside current options.

Render the generated wallpaper images (white-plaid-lace.dim_1280x720.jpg and dark-stussy-grunge.dim_1280x720.jpg) as static assets placed in frontend/public/assets/generated so they can be referenced by the personalization hook and components.
